data: Is the cumulative distribution of SRPRS (normal) greater than that of JAPE for DBpedia?

The question asks whether the cumulative distribution of SRPRS (normal) is greater than that of JAPE for DBpedia. From the caption, we know that the figure compares the degree distributions of entity alignment datasets extracted by different methods. The left graph (a) shows the comparison for DBpedia.

In the left graph (a), the line representing SRPRS (normal) is above the line representing JAPE across all degrees. This indicates that the cumulative distribution of SRPRS (normal) is indeed greater than that of JAPE for DBpedia. Therefore, the answer to the question is yes.
